1.consolidated_definition: Planta de tallos frágiles, de hojas ovaladas de pequeño tamaño que produce la flor llamada siempreviva; es ornamental y medicinal.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Plant with fragile stems, having small oval-shaped leaves that produces the flower known as "siempreviva"; it is ornamental and medicinal.
